brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a busy parent comparing buying separate childproofing products with considering this kit. Help them understand the practical appeal of the kit without claiming it is cheaper, complete for every home, universally compatible or quicker to install.

variants.primary_text: Comparing separate childproofing products? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit brings edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks and door guards together in one kit. That gives you one kit to consider for several childproofing categories, rather than evaluating each category on its own. Childproofing supports—not replaces—adult supervision.
